Cranberry Orange Scones
By: Jennifer Drummond
Published: Saturday, December 3, 2011 - 6:33am

Ingredients




2 cups all-purpose flour
2 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1/4 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup sugar
3 1/2 tablespoon butter,cut into small pieces
1/4 cup cranberries, dried
2 teaspoon orange peel, grated
1/4 cup non fat milk
1/4 Cup fresh orange juice
1 large egg, lightly beaten
For Glaze
1/4 cup powdered sugar
Squirt of fresh orange juice

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375°. 2 Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sugar in a bowl. Cut in butter with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal (I used my hands). Stir in cranberries and rind. Add milk, orange juice and egg stirring just until moist. 3 Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead 15 times or until smooth. 4 Form into an 8 x8x square. Cut 4 even rows into the dough. Cut into triangles.  I got 6 scones per row. (sorry no picture, my hands were to sticky to pull out my camera) 5 Carefully Transfer dough to a baking sheet coated with cooking spray or lined with parchment paper 6 Bake at 375° for 10-12 minutes or until golden.  Let them slightly cool for about 5 minutes.  Meanwhile make your glaze. 7 In a small bowl add your powdered sugar and orange juice (I juiced a 1/4 of an orange) mix until a consistency you like.  Add more sugar if to thin, add more juice if to thick.  Drizzle over the top of scones. 8 Eat and Enjoy!

About

I had one of these at Starbucks and I new I had to make these and I was pleasantly surprised on how wonderful they turned out!  I love them more then Starbucks!!  http://peanutbutterandpeppers.com
